items.title: Multi-agent systems need a shared world, not just shared messages
items.description: Multi-agent AI will not become dependable merely by connecting more capable models. Agents need shared semantics for the world, the work, the evidence, and the authority under which they act.

items.title: A follower is not an audience
items.description: A LinkedIn post received 42 impressions from a profile with roughly 16,500 followers while the platform offered paid amplification. The episode exposes a larger problem: professional visibility has become an opaque market for attention.

items.title: The first deliverable from generative coding should be understanding
items.description: Federal modernization will gain more from generative coding systems when they first make legacy estates legible—mapping dependencies, preserving rationale, and exposing risk before proposing change.
